scope: Actual native heap initialize/insert/malloc/free/fatal policy; request alignment/overflow/exhaustion, all four-block free permutations, deterministic fragmented sequences, NULL/double/invalid frees, header caller LR/padding, whole heap/state and guards
limitations: Scheduler suspend/resume are bounded fixtures. Caller LR is directly controlled; real call-site normalization, scheduler concurrency, complete image linking, hardware and instruction identity remain gates.
